summary: 55-year-old visitor from Kentucky fell and injured her leg on the Tonahutu Trail on the park's west side (~10 miles from trailhead); rangers reached her on horseback after 5 p.m. and brought her out of the backcountry on horseback (one of three NPS rescues that day)
notes: NPS morning report (reported 2010-08-18): Tuesday three-rescue day; reported at noon
